spatial_audit.provider_statement: The source page shows separate training, evaluation and two test areas and gives each area's tile-grid dimensions.
spatial_audit.visible_area_overlap_status: Not independently computable from the prepared tiles: TIFFs contain no CRS, geotransform or GCPs, and the provider does not publish an explicit tile-index-to-coordinate table in this archive. The documented region layout supports geographic separation but cannot verify every footprint.

future_pilot_subset.method: Uniform sampling without replacement from the provider training role, using an isolated NumPy generator and no labels.
future_pilot_subset.spatial_maximin_status: Not defensible from the prepared release because physical tile coordinates cannot be reconstructed reliably.

additional_pilot_subsets.method: Uniform sampling without replacement from the same ordered provider training-role list, using an isolated NumPy generator and no labels.

learning_curve_subsets.method: The historical n=100 selection is not the prefix set of a NumPy permutation generated with its original seed. Following the predeclared fallback, n=25 is sampled without replacement from n=100 and n=500 adds 400 samples drawn without replacement from the remaining provider training role. Source lists use provider numeric order; isolated derived seeds are subset_seed * 1000 + 25 and subset_seed * 1000 + 500. Labels, masks and model outputs are not used.
